programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    runs = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == bg:
                c += 1
                continue
            a = c
            while c < w and row[c] != bg:
                c += 1
            runs.append((c-a, r, a, c, row[a:c]))
    _, _, _, _, pattern = max(runs, key=lambda x: x[0])
    pattern_colors = set(pattern)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and v not in pattern_colors]
    offset = len(pattern) // 2
    for r, c in markers:
        start = c - offset
        for j, v in enumerate(pattern):
            x = start + j
            if 0 <= x < w:
                out[r][x] = v
    return out
'''
